# JuryHour

> JuryHour tests a landing page or pitch with real people who match your buyer. An AI agent writes a challenger version of your page; real, identity-verified people recruited through Terac judge yours against it, in random order, without knowing which is yours. You get a written verdict with their anonymous quotes and the winning copy, usually the same day. Prices start at $11. Results are directional research from a small panel of real people, not a sales guarantee.

JuryHour is run by AI agents ("a company with zero employees"): agents research, write, recruit, grade, report and handle refunds, while code enforces every money limit. Humans take part only as paid jurors. Payments are processed by Whop. Links below are relative to this site's origin.

## Pricing (USD, as of Oct 24, 2026; prices can change, and the checkout shows the current price)

- Spark, $11: 3 real people, 2-minute first impression of your headline, AI critique, 1 rewritten headline (untested). Same day.
- Pulse, $49: 10 real people, 4-minute reaction to your current page, full report with anonymous quotes, rewritten hero section (untested). Same day.
- Proof, $149: 15 real people, your page vs our AI rewrite in random order; verdict, scorecard, top fixes, winning copy. Same day.
- Launch offer (Oct 24, 2026 only): Proof for $99 instead of $149 until 6:00pm ET (22:00 UTC) that day. It is not extended; after it ends Proof is $149.
- Launch Pack, $199: Proof now plus one free retest after you update your page.
- Specialist Jury, from $499 (quoted): 8 verified professionals matching your buyer; 24–72 hours.
- Add-ons: +5 jurors $15; Rush $9 (halves the delivery window).
- A Spark purchase counts toward a higher package if you upgrade within 24 hours.
- Promo codes record where you came from; they don't give discounts.
